entities.summary: Upi Darmayana Tamin is an Indonesian chess player. She was awarded the title of Woman International Master by FIDE in 1985. Tamin won the Asian women's championship of 1996 in Salem, Tamil Nadu, India. In 2002, she won the Anniswati Memorial Cup 1st Leg held in Jakarta.
